description: Frozen fine-tuning protocol: how a pretrained encoder is turned into a classifier per dataset and label regime.

modes.probe: encoder frozen (evaluated in eval mode, embeddings computed once and cached); only the head trains (representation quality)
modes.full: encoder and head train (lower learning rate for the encoder)
modes.scratch: same encoder architecture with random weights, same recipe (the control every pretrained run is compared with)

head: masked mean pooling over tokens (or the event embedding as is) -> LayerNorm(D) -> Linear(D, 64) -> GELU -> Linear(64, 1); fresh initialisation per run
loss: binary cross-entropy with logits, no class weights, no augmentation

schedule.decay: cosine to zero over the planned steps

min_steps_note: small label sets are cycled so that early stopping is armed only after min_steps optimizer steps (MJD sits at chance level for thousands of steps)

early_stopping.metric: inclusive AUC on the frozen coarse subset (cached inputs)

selection: the epoch with the best coarse-subset AUC; its weights score the coarse subset and then the test split once
validation_inputs: the frozen coarse subset of the validation split (manifests/<ds>.json[coarse]); its labels are used for selection only, never for gradients
data_loading: inputs stream through the official reader each epoch in file order and are shuffled inside a buffer of 8192 events
